errors.text_span: Оста X представлява времето, изразено в години, започващо от 0 и завършващо на 10. Скалата е линейна, стойностите са подредени равномерно през интервали от една година. Етикетите са числови и показват годините от 0 до 10.
errors.evidence: The X-axis in the figure has no labels, no units, and no numerical values. The entire description of the X-axis is fabricated.
The Y-axis range starts at 0, not 0.5. The full visible range is from 0 to 2.5.
The labeled intervals on the Y-axis are 0.5 (e.g., 0, 0.5, 1, 1.5), not 0.25.
The description states the blue line is solid, but it fails to mention that the last portion of the line is dotted, which is a key visual feature.
The description incorrectly characterizes the entire orange line as dotted. In the figure, the orange line is mostly solid and only becomes dotted at the end.
The orange line for Bulgaria starts at a value of approximately 0.45, which is clearly below the 0.5 gridline. The stated value of 0.55 is incorrect.

This is an over-generalization of the trend for the orange line. It fails to mention the prominent peak that reaches a value of nearly 1.0 before declining towards the end of the period. The prompt explicitly asks to mention peaks and dips.
The description refers to 'two countries' ('две държави'), but one of the series represents 'ЕС (28 страни)' (EU (28 countries)), which is a supranational union, not a single country.
